# Array Slice

Source: [4574](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4574); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Array Slice](../../api/values/array-slice.md).

<a id="wiki-4574-n1"></a>

- Array Slice returns a copy; Count is an element count, not an end index, and overrunning the source yields fewer elements.
